text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Being selfish just causes trouble for
everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I had to prove that the sacrifices they
made in
sending me off were worth it. I
couldn't afford to
waste a single second.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Because I love my family.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I was afraid my sisters would think I was
getting
special treatment. I didn't want
to see the family I
worked so hard to
support fall apart.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I convinced myself I had to become this reliable older sister. I had to protect our cozy home in any way I could.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(But the truth is I'm not the big hero I
thought I
could be. I'm still just plain old
me...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(And my family loves me just the way I
am...
They're happy to bless me with all
their support.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I... am Ines Fujin, and right now, I can
just keep on
enjoying racing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... These cheers are so loud!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This feels incredible!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(If running with 100% of my strength is
what I
do...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I want to spread my arms wide and
welcome
everyone's feelings with 100%
of my energy too.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, Trainer! And I want to discuss
our next
goal!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking we could do the
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is a 2,200-meter
G1 held
in June. It's a grand prix,
meaning the most
popular runners get to
take the turf.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You need a lot of fans to run in a grand
prix,
right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So that got me thinking—maybe running
in the
Takarazuka Kinen means you're,
like, carrying the
weight of people's
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I know that compared to others, there
might not
be as many people who see
their dreams in me,
but still...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to stand on that great big stage
and live
up to those dreams anyway. I
want to show that I
can bear that
burden.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Caught up in her sheer determination, I
find
myself imagining who else might be
running in this
year's Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ryan and McQueen?
choice_data_list: なら、メジロライアンたちにも勝たないとな
なら、メジロライアンたちにも勝たないとね
choice_data_list_en: Then we'll have to beat Mejiro Ryan and the others too!
Then we'll have to beat Mejiro Ryan and the others too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
How do you know they'll be there? The
spring G1
races have only just started,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan and Mejiro McQueen have
both been
the subject of an enormous
amount of attention
lately.
choice_data_list: それは期待されているウマ娘だからかな
choice_data_list_en: Maybe it's because she's an Umamusume with high expectations on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if "perfect" is the word, but
the way
McQueen stalks the pace
before overpowering
the competition is
really something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then there's Ryan, who's gained
popularity
by displaying a level of
determination worthy of
her family
name, remaining resilient no matter

what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They've both become pillars of the
current racing
scene.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So they're going to be entering for sure.
If this is
going to be the race of people's
dreams, those
two have got to be there.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Now I get it! I really am hopeless,
aren't
I?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Oh—I mean, thanks for the vote of

confidence, but... I wasn't really talking
about my
chances in the race.
choice_data_list: アイネスも2人のように期待されてるよ！
choice_data_list_en: People have high expectations for you too, Ines, just like those two!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's just that... I've been so focused on
myself
recently, I feel like I've been
living under a rock.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's like the only thing I've been thinking
about is
me, you know? I really think I
should broaden my
perspective.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? You always have to back me up like that, don't you?
choice_data_list: でも夢中になるのは悪いことじゃない
choice_data_list_en: Still, getting absorbed in something isn't a bad thing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's my job as her trainer to support her,
after all.
And besides...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But I'm pretty sure I'm already too
absorbed
in it...
choice_data_list: アイネスには走りに夢中でいてほしいから
choice_data_list_en: Because I want Ines to stay focused purely on running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching Ines Fujin scratch her cheek
sheepishly,
I'm reminded of the
conversations I've had with
others about
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We all feel exactly the same way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why, as her trainer, I'll continue to
do my
best to support her! And now it's
time to focus on
our next goal—the
Takarazuka Kinen!
choice_data_list: （全力で彼女に走りを楽しんでほしい）
choice_data_list_en: (I want her to enjoy running with everything she's got.)
